nodes.instructions:
1. Search company_data for the vendor's invoice files and read every candidate.
2. Pick the invoice with the latest invoice date and note its amount and due date.
3. Read company_data/policies.md and compare the amount against the approval threshold.
4. Open the payables add-invoice page and read it before typing.
5. Fill vendor, amount and due date using the selectors the page actually exposes.
6. Submit the form; if it fails, read the page and recover.
7. Hand off to verification and act on its result.
